shell.access.kit.focus: Keyboard cursor. Gumalaw gamit ang arrow keys, pumili gamit ang Enter, lumipat sa susunod na malapit na bagay gamit ang Tab, ilista ang mga key gamit ang question mark.
shell.access.kit.keys: Gumagalaw ang cursor gamit ang arrow keys, Shift para sa mas malalaking hakbang, Control para sa mas maliliit. Pumipili ang Enter. Tinatanggap ng Space. Lumilipat sa susunod o nakaraang malapit na bagay ang Tab at Shift Tab. Inilalarawan ng D ang view. Sinasabi ng W kung nasaan ka. Inililista ng N ang malapit. Sinasabi ng S kung ano ang napili. Inuulit ng R ang sinabi. Ino-on o ino-off ng V ang boses. Pumupunta sa command line ang Slash.

shell.engines.title: Engines
shell.engines.button.title: Engines: schematics, networks, motion, queues, schedule, requirements, risk, live data, circuits, boards, systems at PLC
shell.engines.what: Patakbuhin ang isa sa mga shared engine sa model na i-paste mo o sa isa sa mga worked example nito. Lahat ay tumatakbo sa page na ito; walang ipinapadala kahit saan. Lumalabas din ang mga problema sa Problems panel.
shell.engines.more: May {n} pang row na hindi ipinakita.
shell.engines.schematic.name: Schematics at connectivity
shell.engines.schematic.summary: Mga symbol, pin, net, wire at terminal number, cross-reference, plano, bill of materials at labindalawang rule check.
shell.engines.network.name: Pipe network at power system
shell.engines.network.summary: Pipe network flows at pressures, power load flow, short circuit, protection curves.
shell.engines.motion.name: Motion at mga robot
shell.engines.motion.summary: Robot chain, forward at inverse kinematics, joint torque, trajectory, URDF in at out; closed planar loops (four-bar, slider-crank, parallel robots) na may Grashof class at velocity ratio.
shell.engines.des.name: Queue at flow simulation
shell.engines.des.summary: Discrete-event simulation ng queue, server, conveyor at shift, na may replications.
shell.engines.schedule.name: Schedule at cost
shell.engines.schedule.summary: Critical path na may lag at calendar, resources, cost curve at earned value.
shell.engines.trace.name: Requirements at traceability
shell.engines.trace.summary: Requirements na naka-link sa mga element at test, coverage matrix, impact, ReqIF in at out.
shell.engines.risk.name: Risk at reliability
shell.engines.risk.summary: Fault tree, reliability block, FMEA, Weibull fit, Markov model.
shell.engines.live.name: Live data
shell.engines.live.summary: Modbus, MQTT at BACnet message codec at tag store na may marker (read-only).
shell.engines.em.name: Circuit at field
shell.engines.em.summary: Circuit solver para sa netlist: operating point, sweep, AC at transient.
shell.engines.pcb.name: Boards
shell.engines.pcb.summary: Place at route ng board mula sa netlist, i-check ang design rules, isulat ang Gerber at IPC-2581.
shell.engines.sys.name: Systems (lumped models)
shell.engines.sys.summary: Acausal model sa electrical, thermal, hydraulic at mechanical domain; Modelica subset reader.
shell.engines.plc.name: Controls (PLC)
shell.engines.plc.summary: IEC 61131-3 structured text: i-check, i-scan, at panoorin ang mga variable.
